arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus course-fitted current: a sudden drop means extra drag (rudder snag) or a current change

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power plus fitted current: rudder snag, current change or pod drift?
pod shaft power near zero: pod failure or paddler stopped

arguments.text: 1.0 min: very hot start (shaft 278 W vs CP 185, pod reserve 58 pct, empties in 310 m). Cued ease to 157 s/500 (model sustainable 157.7). Watches: drag_jump (drag_gap=push_local-push_along < -0.2 for 40 s), pod_dead, pod_reserve_low. Plan: settle near sustainable pace, check CP vs evidence (holding power above CP without fade means CP too low), keep reserve for final sprint ~last 400-600 m.
Settle into race rhythm now, long strong strokes.
